mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rooms (title, password_hash, password_plain, max_players, status, host_user_id, member_count, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{title}, #{passwordHash}, #{passwordPlain}, #{maxPlayers}, #{status}, #{hostUserId}, #{memberCount}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE rooms SET status = #{status}, member_count = #{memberCount}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE rooms SET status = 'CLOSED', closed_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status <> 'CLOSED'
UPDATE rooms SET host_user_id = #{hostUserId}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('OPEN', 'FULL')
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.title, r.password_hash, r.password_plain, r.max_players, r.status, r.host_user_id, r.member_count, r.created_at, r.updated_at, r.closed_at, (r.password_hash IS NOT NULL AND r.password_hash <> '') AS has_password, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(u.nickname), ''), u.username) AS host_nickname, u.avatar_url AS host_avatar_url, (CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(u.role, '')) = 'ADMIN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS host_is_admin FROM rooms r LEFT JOIN users u ON r.host_user_id = u.id WHERE r.id = #{id}

SELECT r.id, r.title, r.password_hash, r.password_plain, r.max_players, r.status, r.host_user_id, r.member_count, r.created_at, r.updated_at, r.closed_at, (r.password_hash IS NOT NULL AND r.password_hash <> '') AS has_password, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(u.nickname), ''), u.username) AS host_nickname, u.avatar_url AS host_avatar_url, (CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(u.role, '')) = 'ADMIN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS host_is_admin FROM rooms r LEFT JOIN users u ON r.host_user_id = u.id WHERE r.status IN ('OPEN', 'FULL') ORDER BY CASE r.status WHEN 'OPEN' THEN 1 WHEN 'FULL' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, r.created_at DESC

SELECT r.id, r.title, r.password_hash, r.password_plain, r.max_players, r.status, r.host_user_id, r.member_count, r.created_at, r.updated_at, r.closed_at, (r.password_hash IS NOT NULL AND r.password_hash <> '') AS has_password, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(u.nickname), ''), u.username) AS host_nickname, u.avatar_url AS host_avatar_url, (CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(u.role, '')) = 'ADMIN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS host_is_admin FROM rooms r LEFT JOIN users u ON r.host_user_id = u.id WHERE r.host_user_id = #{hostUserId} AND r.status IN ('OPEN', 'FULL') ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT r.id, r.title, r.password_hash, r.password_plain, r.max_players, r.status, r.host_user_id, r.member_count, r.created_at, r.updated_at, r.closed_at, (r.password_hash IS NOT NULL AND r.password_hash <> '') AS has_password, NULL AS host_nickname, NULL AS host_avatar_url, 0 AS host_is_admin FROM rooms r WHERE r.status = 'CLOSED' AND r.closed_at IS NOT NULL AND r.closed_at < #{cutoff} ORDER BY r.closed_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM rooms WHERE status = #{status}
